impact: Direct hit to the BE position; higher rates and AI capex doubts are pressuring the whole AI power group even as Bloom's deal pipeline grows.
summary: Bloom Energy shares fell about 4.6% in morning trading Tuesday after a rally the prior session that followed its 900MW NTT DATA data center partnership and a Barclays upgrade to Overweight. The drop was tied to profit-taking and October CPI showing core inflation rising for a third straight month. AI power names including GE Vernova, Vertiv and Bloom have lost 10% to 24% over the past week on AI-spending worries.
title: Bloom Energy falls 4.6% on profit-taking and hot CPI
